groups.title: llama.cpp pull requests and issues we built on

credits.name: DeepSeek
credits.made: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a 763B MoE.
credits.used_for: The model behind the Strata recipe.

credits.name: RecursiveSI
credits.made: Flint, a 40B MoE with 2.5B active parameters.
credits.used_for: The model behind the 128k coding recipe.

credits.name: ccore
credits.made: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder and the ThreeJS-3D-Scenes dataset.
credits.used_for: The fine-tune we serve; the render eval's prompts come from the dataset's validation split.

credits.name: Qwen
credits.made: Qwen3.5-4B with its multi-token-prediction head, and Qwen3.8-27B.
credits.used_for: The 15 mtp.* tensors grafted back into the 3D coder came from Qwen3.5-4B; Kintsugi-27B is built on Qwen3.8-27B.

credits.name: Thinking Machines
credits.made: Inkling-2-Mini, a 26.4B looped MoE with image input and NVFP4 experts.
credits.used_for: The model behind the loop-core placement recipe; our NVFP4 repack copies the checkpoint's own 4-bit experts.

credits.name: Cary Palmer
credits.made: Kintsugi-27B: Qwen3.8-27B at 2.47 bpw as EXL3 trellis codes, the DFlash2 drafter, and the llama.cpp fork and bundle that run it.
credits.used_for: Model, drafter and engine for the Kintsugi recipe, used as shipped in bundle v1.1.1.

credits.name: ggml-org
credits.made: Reference GGUFs for Flint and Inkling-2-Mini, with imatrix.
credits.used_for: Flint-Q4_K_M.gguf and Inkling-2-Mini-IQ4_NL.gguf are the files the two recipes serve; the Q8_0 files are the KLD references.

credits.name: Unsloth
credits.made: Dynamic 2-bit and 3-bit GGUFs of Inkling-2-Mini, the DSpark drafter GGUF, and UD quants of Flint.
credits.used_for: The Mainline_Support files are the max-speed options of the Inkling recipe (41.4 tok/s whole-on-GPU); UD-Q3_K_XL was the smaller-expert test on Flint.

credits.name: bartowski
credits.made: GGUF quants of Flint with a published imatrix.
credits.used_for: The imatrix used when we requantized only the RAM-resident experts.

credits.name: ISTA-DASLab
credits.made: The GSQ-RCO quantisation of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and its GGUFs.
credits.used_for: The 2.00 bpw build whose "runs on 12 GB" claim the DeepSeek recipe checks.

credits.name: z-lab
credits.made: The Qwen3.5-4B-DFlash drafter.
credits.used_for: Measured against MTP on the 3D coder: fastest while writing code (163 tok/s), not used because acceptance falls to 4-7% while reasoning.

credits.name: llama.cpp (ggml-org and contributors)
credits.made: The inference engine: CUDA backend, MoE expert placement and the adaptive MoE cache, MTP and DFlash speculation, the converter, llama-bench and llama-perplexity.
credits.used_for: The engine for Flint, the 3D coder and Inkling-2-Mini, and the base of the Kintsugi fork.

credits.name: Strata (Niko1221)
credits.made: An engine, packer and install planner that runs frontier-size MoEs from VRAM, RAM and SSD together.
credits.used_for: Runs DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 763B on the 12 GB card.

credits.name: pcuenca
credits.made: Inkling 2 Mini support in llama.cpp (#32694) and the build-mask-in-chunks PR (#32752).
credits.used_for: #32694 is why the model runs on llama.cpp at all; #32752 is one of two open PRs we measured that make 64k fit without our patches.

credits.name: danielhanchen
credits.made: The loop-slot fix after the scale pass (#32704).
credits.used_for: Made NVFP4 GGUFs work on stock master, so our round-1 loop-scale patch was dropped.

credits.name: mtclinton
credits.made: The issue reporting NaN perplexity for inkling2_loop on CUDA (#32710), with its analysis.
credits.used_for: The upstream record of the op-offload NaN our placement matrix measures.

credits.name: pwilkin
credits.made: Compact bias on FLASH_ATTN_EXT (#32740) and Inkling 2 DSpark support (#32218).
credits.used_for: #32740 measured here at 2.5x prefill at 8k, 2.9x at 62k and +20% decode at 62k; #32218 is the drafter support behind our DSpark test.

credits.name: Izento
credits.made: Fit that prioritises looped MoE layers in device memory (#32777).
credits.used_for: With --fit-target 0 it is the only automatic placement that matched our hand-written one.

credits.name: Oxsilaris06
credits.made: Measured DSpark fixes for 16 GB cards (#32773).
credits.used_for: Part of the DSpark build we tested at 32k.

credits.name: 0xSero / Sybil Solutions
credits.made: The inference-optimisation skill (ceilings first, one change per run with controls, output gated as well as speed) and the local-ai-registry.
credits.used_for: The tuning method behind the Flint and Inkling recipes; its q8_0 KV gotcha is one we confirmed on Flint.

credits.name: apolinario
credits.made: The decision-index evaluation kit.
credits.used_for: Scored the loop-pass experiment (3 passes 40.13, 2 passes 4.95, 1 pass 2.59).

credits.name: multimodalart
credits.made: The Jev Decision Index Space and its published index.
credits.used_for: The reference index our loop-pass scores are placed against.

credits.name: Hugging Face
credits.made: The Hub: model, dataset and Space hosting, with an open API that exposes file sizes and sha256 checksums.
credits.used_for: Every model, quant and drafter in these recipes is fetched from the Hub at a pinned revision and checked against the API's sha256; the base model's MTP tensors were fetched with HTTP range requests.

credits.name: NVIDIA
credits.made: The GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB, CUDA, cuBLAS, CUDA graphs and nvidia-smi; the NVFP4 4-bit format.
credits.used_for: Every recipe runs on CUDA on this card; cuBLAS SGEMV is our VRAM bandwidth probe (342 GB/s), nvidia-smi dmon is the telemetry, and Inkling's experts ship in NVFP4.
